policy_floor: catastrophic-if-violated clause in a routed row: Forensics tier clause 8 (hard-cutover deployment contract: no doc may describe an upgrade path or operation alongside earlier builds)
trigger: an operator reads docs/user-manual/upgrading.md "Order in a fresh deployment"
summary: The new paragraph kept "Agents delivered by the server's own update channel follow this order automatically", which describes an agent upgrade flow. Deleted in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: The sentence presents an upgrade path the deployment contract excludes; the docs reviewer derived LOW but the clause is a policy floor, so the gate reads BLOCKING until fixed.

trigger: a macOS release that reports a folder mount under /System/Volumes/Data (the firmlinked user tree); not reproduced on Darwin 25.6, where f_mntonname is /Users/<name>/...
summary: mount_entry_is_personal matched roots only at the start of the path, so /System/Volumes/Data/Users/<name> would have passed un-redacted. The Data-volume prefix is now stripped before the match; tests pin Users, home, the bare volume and a non-boundary lookalike. Fixed in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: The ADR claims the personal roots are redacted; the code missed one spelling of them.

trigger: a control byte (0x1F, 0x1E, NUL) inside a root segment of the mount path; only the OS controls the root, so no real mount produces it
summary: Redaction ran before clamp_field strips the framing bytes, so "/Us\x1fers/alice" was not matched and the blob then held /Users/alice. The framing bytes are removed from the mount cell before the match. Fixed in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: Order of scrub and match let a personal path through on a constructed input.

trigger: a plugin field holding two or more escaped pipes
summary: Changing the while to an if in the unescaped split survived every test (each fixture had one escaped pipe per field). A two-pipe case was added; the mutation is now caught. Fixed in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: The test suite did not observe the behaviour its names claim.

trigger: running the agent suite by test name
summary: Two new TEST_CASE names held a comma, which a Catch2 by-name filter splits on and matches nothing. Renamed in e2961a438 and d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: A name that cannot be filtered; behaviour unaffected.

trigger: an operator or auditor reads the Windows-volumes promise in ADR-0016
summary: The return path of the Windows volume rows ("when the platform gap is closed") named no tracker. #3925 (plugin OS calls have no deadline) is now cited in the ADR and the disk_actions README, with a note that the reason is expected and benign. Fixed in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: A promised follow-up with no anchor; not one of the six required-doc items, so sized as degraded guidance.

trigger: a reader takes "machine-scope, no per-user data" as covering every column
summary: The scope text stood beside the new redaction text with no statement of what is not covered, and said nothing on consent or the works-council trigger. Both documents now name the residual routes (other folder mounts, Linux user-media roots, other columns, v1 host name/domain/OU), state that redaction is not a consent mechanism and does not change the identifier capability. Fixed in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: Unqualified prose overstated a minimisation control.

trigger: an operator wants to know how many devices report each section state
summary: No documented way to count constrained versus unavailable sections or read the new reasons; the existing alerts key on ingest outcomes only. The count query over device_inventory_store.device_ci_section is now in the manual; no alert added (a permanent condition would fire forever). Fixed in d7e71e772.
classification_rationale: Observability guidance, not a required doc under the six-item list.

recorded_by: pr-monitor orchestrator (correcting the E6 basis after the Gate 8 re-review)
summary: Re-derived: E6 needs the wrong outcome PROVEN unable to occur in production; "not reproduced on Darwin 25.6" is only an absence of a repro on one OS. Exposure is E5 (a macOS release that reports the Data-volume spelling), so I1 derives HIGH. Fixed in d7e71e772; the fix is what clears the gate, not the E6 cap.

recorded_by: pr-monitor orchestrator (correcting the E6 basis after the Gate 8 re-review)
summary: Re-derived: only the OS controls the root segment, but a directory named with a framing byte at the filesystem root is not proven impossible, so E6 does not apply. Exposure is E5 and I1 derives HIGH. Fixed in d7e71e772 (framing bytes removed before the match).
